skill.name: Kale Skill Builder
skill.description: Create, revise, and test reusable skills for CAIL Sandbox.

starters.title: Create a skill
starters.subtitle: for a recurring task
starters.content: Help me create a reusable skill. I will describe my task, required inputs, and expected output.

starters.title: Revise a skill
starters.subtitle: using observed results
starters.content: Help me revise an existing skill. I will provide its instructions, a test request, and the output that needs to change.

tool.name: CAIL Tool Creator
tool.description: Create, revise, and test Python tools for CAIL Sandbox.

starters.title: Create a tool
starters.subtitle: for a specific task
starters.content: Help me create a Python tool for Open WebUI. I will describe its inputs, expected output, and any required data access.

starters.title: Revise a tool
starters.subtitle: using observed results
